findings.comment: Single-lot site should not include multi-lot or cohesive development notes. If such notes are present on the cover sheet, they must be removed or clarified to reflect single-lot status.

Restrictive covenant for Integrated Pest Management (IPM) plan required for biofiltration pond facility has not been recorded. Cover sheet Block 12 shows blank document number for IPM covenant ('For Integrated Pest Management Plan, see agreement filed in document No.____________'). The recorded IPM restrictive covenant document number must be completed and updated on the cover sheet, and evidence of City Law Department approval and county recordation must be provided.

Restrictive covenant form and completeness cannot be verified; the IPM covenant document is not recorded (blank document number on cover sheet). Submit the executed, notarized IPM restrictive covenant (approved by City Law Department) and evidence of county recordation to verify compliance with form and content requirements.

Biofiltration/detention pond facility is located partially within the existing recorded City of Austin Drainage Easement (Instrument 2011021137, NE corner). The easement grant document reserves unlimited rights for City to construct, operate, and maintain drainage infrastructure; any on-site improvements require City (Watershed Protection Department) coordination and approval. Evidence of City coordination and approval for pond location within easement must be provided; alternatively, demonstrate that pond layout avoids the easement area entirely.

applicableAreas: Site plan sheets (wastewater easement, sidewalk easement areas)
findings.comment: Proposed easements (wastewater and sidewalk easements shown on site plan) are not clearly designated with 'proposed' labels; instead, they show blank document numbers ('Doc# _______'). All proposed easements must be explicitly labeled as 'PROPOSED' on site plan sheets to distinguish them from recorded (existing) easements, which must show recording information (volume/page or document number).

applicableAreas: Site plan (cover sheet and all plan sheets)
findings.comment: A comprehensive inventory of all required or proposed legal instruments (recorded easements, proposed easements, drainage easement documents, restrictive covenants, license agreements) is not clearly identified and listed on the site plan cover sheet or in the comment response letter. Provide a consolidated table or note on the cover sheet identifying the status, location, and document numbers for all legal instruments required for the project.
